name: 調べてから、出どころ付きで答える
plain: 答える前に「何を調べるか」を見せ、調べた出どころ（ページの場所）を添えて答えます。調べられないときは、そう言います。
placeholder: 例: 近所の図書館で使える電子書籍サービスは？

steps.label: 調べること
steps.system: List 2 to 4 short things you will look up to answer the question, as a numbered list, in the language of the question. Nothing else.

steps.label: 答えと出どころ
steps.system: Answer the question using what you can actually look up now. After the answer, list the pages you used as plain URLs under the heading 'Sources'. Never invent a URL. If you cannot browse, say so in the first sentence and answer only from what you know, marked as unchecked. Use the language of the question.
